P.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate {{tip|fury|{{as|25 Fury}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}, reduced to {{as|{{ap|25*0.16}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|minions}}, and to {{as|{{ap|25*0.2}}|Fury}} per hit against {{tip|ward|wards}} and [[jungle plants]]. '''Rek'Sai's''' {{tip|abilities}} other than ''{{ai|Queen's Wrath|Rek'Sai}}'' generate {{as|25 Fury}} upon hitting at least one unit. ''{{ai|Prey Seeker|Rek'Sai}}'' does not generate {{as|Fury}} against non-{{tip|champions}} hit. After 8 seconds of being [[out of combat]], she loses {{as|20 Fury}} per second.
P.description2: When '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}}, she consumes her current {{as|Fury}} over 3 seconds to {{tip|heal}} for {{pp|0 to 100|0 to 100 by 5|type=Fury|key=%|color=Fury}} of {{as|{{pp|9 + (20-9)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} '''maximum''' health}}, stopping once fully consumed or she reaches {{sti|health|{{as|full health}}}}. If she starts generating {{as|Fury}} while {{sbc|Burrowed}}, the consumption occurs after 5 seconds.

Q.name: Queen's Wrath
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' gains {{sti|{{as|35% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds. Her next {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} within the duration will have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the target and surrounding enemies. ''Queen's Wrath's'' damage to the primary target is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30 to 50}}% AD}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|30*3 to 50*3}}% AD}}}}
Q.description2: If '''Rek'Sai''' completes an attack, the duration is refreshed, for up to 3 total empowered attacks.
Q.description3: ''Queen's Wrath {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rek'Sai's''' basic attack timer.''

Q.name: Prey Seeker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' fires a void bolt in the target direction that detonates on the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for 5 seconds.

W.name: Burrow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|Burrowed}}, reducing her {{sti|attack range by 50}} and her {{tip|sight}} radius to 385 units, while gaining access to her {{sbc|Burrowed}} abilities. She also becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, as well as ''Tremor Sense''.
W.description2: {{sbc|Tremor Sense:}} '''Rek'Sai''' and her allies gain {{tip|obscured vision}} of non-visible, moving enemies within range at a rate of once every second.
W.description3: Once ''Burrow'' has been learned, '''Rek'Sai''' automatically becomes {{sbc|Burrowed}} upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or [[death|respawning]].

W.name: Unburrow
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}}, gaining access to her {{sbc|Un-Burrowed}} abilities and emerging from the ground to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knock them up}} for 1 second. {{tip|Minions}} and small {{tip|monsters}} are instead {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} a short distance. Targets hit cannot be {{tip|airborne|displaced}} by ''Unburrow'' again for some time.
W.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can also trigger ''Unburrow'' by issuing an attack command, casting the ability once she is in attack range of the target and applying the {{tip|airborne|knock up}} against them.
W.description3: '''''Rek'Sai''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.15}} seconds after hitting an enemy with Unburrow.''

E.name: Furious Bite
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' bites the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}.
E.description2: At maximum {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}, ''Furious Bite'' deals {{ap|1.2*100|round=2}}% damage and is converted to {{ccs|{{as|true damage}}|true}}.

E.name: Tunnel
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, leaving behind a ''Tunnel'' that has two interconnected entrances and lasts up to 10 minutes. The ''Tunnel'' can be traversed again when '''Rek'Sai''' targets either entrance, causing her to {{tip|dash}} to the selected entrance before {{tip|dash|travelling}} through the ''Tunnel'' to the opposite side. Once a ''Tunnel'' has been traversed, it is shut down for a few seconds during which '''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter it again.
E.description2: '''Rek'Sai''' can have up to 8 ''Tunnels'' active on the battlefield at once. Deploying ''Tunnels'' beyond the maximum causes the oldest one to be destroyed. Enemy {{tip|champions}} can destroy a ''Tunnel'' by standing on either entrance for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, granting them {{g|5}} upon successfully destroying the ''Tunnel''.
E.description3: If '''Rek'Sai''' attempts to enter a ''Tunnel'' while {{sbc|{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai|Un-Burrowed}}}}, she will automatically ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' upon interacting with it, and automatically ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}'' after exiting it. This does not place ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' on cooldown nor trigger ''{{ai|Fury of the Xer'Sai|Rek'Sai}}'', but does trigger other ''Burrow'' effects and ''{{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}}''. If ''{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}}'' is on cooldown at the time of interacting with the ''Tunnel'', the cooldown will be reset.
E.description4: '''''Rek'Sai''' cannot enter a tunnel while {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''

R.name: Void Rush
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Rek'Sai''' applies ''Marked as Prey'' to enemy champions she damages, lasting for 5 seconds.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rek'Sai''' singles out the target enemy champion ''Marked as Prey'', becoming {{tip|displacement immune}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} into the ground, as well as {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target for {{tt|{{fd|1.5}} seconds|From the start of the cast time, estimated}}. After {{tt|{{fd|0.9}} seconds|Estimated, from end of cast time}}, she {{tip|blink|blinks}} to a location {{tt|near the target|Relative to her casting position}}, becoming targetable again and emerging from the ground to {{tip|dash|pounce}} at them. Upon arrival, she slashes at the target with her claws, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} 125 units through them.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|15 to 25}}% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
R.description3: ''If cast while in {{sbc|{{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai|Burrowed}}}} form, '''Rek'Sai''' will automatically {{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}} at the end of Void Rush's cast time, placing {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} on a 1-second cooldown without triggering Unburrow's effects. If {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} is already on cooldown, its remaining cooldown is set to 1 second.''
